title: Earth’s forests lost 60% of their canopy during ancient global warming—could it happen again?
description: Ancient forests endured extreme global warming over 56 million years ago. This warming event caused a significant loss of forest canopy cover. Forests took over 100,000 years to fully recover from this damage. Modern forests face similar challenges with faster carbon emissions. Past warming events offer crucial lessons for current climate change.
